beats.care: Coming back by bus to Kilambakkam? Expect crowds and a 10–15 minute wait for Metro trains late at night.
beats.what: CMRL runs a Sunday timetable on Tuesday. Blue and Green Lines run 5 am–11 pm; the Yellow Line runs 7 am–9 pm.
beats.why: Monday and Tuesday are Ayudha Pooja and Vijayadashami holidays, so fewer people ride.

cards.body: Blue and Green Lines: every 10 minutes 5 am–noon, 7 minutes noon–8 pm, 10 minutes 8–10 pm, 15 minutes 10–11 pm. Yellow Line: every 15 minutes.
